goal: Route audit and live route replacement in mobile/lib/routing/app_router.dart.
summary: Performed comprehensive route audit and live screen replacement across the Flutter mobile client. Enumerated and eliminated all 11 leftover placeholder classes in app_router.dart (ExplorePlaceholder, CollectionPlaceholder, AchievementsPlaceholder, ProfilePlaceholder, UrnViewerPlaceholder, MotifDetailPlaceholder, LessonPlaceholder, QuizPlaceholder, QuestsPlaceholder, QuestDetailPlaceholder, SettingsPlaceholder) and eliminated 100% of 'Coming Soon' dummy text from production routes. Replaced quests routes with production-grade QuestsScreen and QuestDetailScreen backed by a full Riverpod provider (questsNotifierProvider), Hive storage caching, and canonical heritage quests. Verified live screen backing for Friends (FriendsScreen), Practice (PracticeScreen & PracticeSessionScreen), Settings (SettingsScreen), and Profile Edit (PersonalInfoScreen). Configured clean redirects for alias/unlaunched routes ('/', '/home', '/badges', '/leaderboard', '/about') and verified the GoRouter errorBuilder 404 fallback.
invariants_enforced: ZERO_PLACEHOLDER_LEAKAGE: All 11 placeholder classes and all 'Coming Soon' dummy text removed from mobile/lib/routing/app_router.dart and active features.
LIVE_SCREEN_BACKING: All 24 core routes resolve to concrete screen files on disk with real state management (Riverpod/Hive) and interactive user flows.

QUESTS_FEATURE_COMPLETION: Quests (/quests) and Quest Detail (/quests/:questId) mapped to QuestsScreen and QuestDetailScreen, backed by Quest domain entity, steps, objectives, rewards, and local cache.

UNLAUNCHED_ROUTE_CLEAN_REDIRECTS: Unlaunched and alias routes ('/', '/home', '/badges', '/leaderboard', '/about') cleanly redirect to live production screens ('/explore', '/achievements', '/settings') without broken states.
ERROR_404_FALLBACK_GRACEFUL_DEGRADATION: GoRouter errorBuilder catches unhandled routes and displays localized ErrorScreen with a direct navigation button back to /explore.
NEGATIVE_ABUSE_FAIL_CLOSED: Routes with placeholder tokens or missing disk files fail audit closed with typed domain exceptions (PlaceholderRouteError, ForbiddenDummyTextError, UnbackedRouteError).

changes.description: Replaced QuestsPlaceholder and QuestDetailPlaceholder with live QuestsScreen and QuestDetailScreen; added editProfile route to PersonalInfoScreen; added clean redirects for '/', '/home', '/badges', '/leaderboard', and '/about'; removed all 11 leftover placeholder classes.
Created Quest, QuestReward, QuestObjective, QuestStep, and QuestStatus domain entities with JSON serialization and canonical Vietnamese heritage quest seeds.
Created QuestsNotifier StateNotifier and questsNotifierProvider integrating Hive storage caching, API synchronization, and status filtering.
Created QuestsScreen with progress summary card, filter chips (Tất cả, Đang làm, Đã xong, Đã khóa), quest cards with linear progress, rewards, and navigation.
Created QuestDetailScreen with overview card, reward breakdown (+XP, +Gems), multi-step objective checklist, and dynamic action CTA button.
Created automated mobile route audit engine parsing Dart router AST, verifying screen bindings, checking redirect routes, and enforcing zero-placeholder invariants.
Exported mobile route audit functions and typed exceptions for centralized domain consumption.

Created comprehensive 21-test suite verifying route audit, absence of dummy text, Quests screen & provider integrity, Friends, Practice, Settings, clean redirects, ErrorScreen, negative abuse edge cases, and backend API contract parity.
